subject: Vendr presign window: upload cadence, role gating, and escalation path
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantapay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr presign window proposal and roles - QuantaPay

Hi Nikhil / QuantaPay team,

Great to be working with you on the Vendr onboarding for QuantaPay. To keep the evidence upload coordinated with your internal SOC 2 mapping, we propose running two 8-hour presign upload windows next week (Option A: Tue 24th 01:00–09:00 UTC; Option B: Thu 26th 13:00–21:00 UTC).

What we need from you to finalize the window:
- Confirm which window (A/B) you prefer and which timezone your engineers will operate in.
- Confirm the list of upload actors and their Vendr roles (uploader, steward, verifier). Vendr requires distinct steward accounts for proof-of-possession attestations.
- Any presign throughput constraints (max concurrent uploads / per-file size caps).

I attached an upload matrix with recommended concurrency and a short presign playbook. We can also provide a temporary service-account-based S3 presign if your infra team prefers.

[Attachment: Vendr_upload_window_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]
[Attachment: Presign_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf, 170KB)]

If useful, I can set up a 30-min ops call to walk the QuantaPay SRE through the manifest format and retry behavior.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Onboarding Lead, Vendr

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantapay.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr presign window proposal and roles - QuantaPay

Thanks Alex — tagging our internal owners. A few constraints from our side before we lock a window:

1) We'd prefer Option A (Tue 24th 01:00–09:00 UTC) to minimize overlap with APAC traffic, but we need to confirm infra availability.
2) Upload actors:
   - Uploader: quanta-ingest-sa@quantapay.com (service account)
   - Steward: mina.haddad@redwood.com (evidence steward)
   - Verifier: laura.bennett@redwood.com (security reviewer)

3) Throughput: we cannot exceed 16 concurrent uploads per service account during the window due to our egress shaping; single file max 2GB.

4) Can Vendr accept pre-signed URLs generated by our S3 service account, or do you require Vendr-generated presigns tied to Vendr IAM? Our preference is to generate presigns (we can short TTL them to 20 minutes).

5) Mina and I need the manifest template and a sample mapping of attestations -> CAIQ SIG questions. Also — do you record DSA/md5 hashes on ingestion (we need proof-of-possession mapping for SOC 2 evidence).

If Vendr can confirm (4) and share a sample manifest, we can lock Option A by EOD Wednesday (19 May).

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Security Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantapay.com>
Cc: support@vendr.io
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr presign window proposal and roles - QuantaPay

Hi Nikhil and team,

Thanks for the details — quick answers inline and next steps below.

- Window: Option A (Tue 24th 01:00–09:00 UTC) is fine. We recommend starting a 30-minute warmup at 00:30 UTC to validate presign TTLs.
- Presign model: Vendr supports both vendor-side presigns (Vendr generates one-time presigned URLs tied to our upload workflow) and customer-generated presigns. For customer-generated presigns we require the manifest to include the presign TTL and the uploader service-account identity. If you choose customer presigns, please ensure TTL <= 30m and include the proof-of-possession header with the upload.
- Hashing: Vendr computes SHA256 on ingest and stores the hash as part of the evidence manifest (we also persist the original filename and upload timestamp). That satisfies our ingestion POAM for SOC 2 evidence.

Attached is a sample manifest (JSON schema) and the upload matrix with recommended concurrency limits for Vendr's ingestion pipeline. 

[Attachment: Vendr_upload_window_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]
[Attachment: Presign_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf, 170KB)]

Operational notes:
- Please make sure the steward account (Mina) has a Vendr "steward" role — this enables manual approval of attestations during the ingest.
- If you expect >10k files in the window, please notify support@vendr.io 48 hours in advance for quota bumping.

We can run the 30-min ops call on Wed 19 May at 08:00 UTC — does that work for your infra lead?

Best,
Samira Patel
Program Manager, Vendr Onboarding

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr presign window proposal and roles - QuantaPay

Quick follow-ups from a mapping / evidence perspective:

- Mina / Nikhil: when Vendr ingests the SHA256, can we get an export artifact that maps Vendr-evidence-id -> SHA256 -> original manifest id? We'll want that for our internal evidence ledger and to include in the SOC 2 readiness pack.
- For KMS: QuantaPay will be using their KMS to sign upload metadata. Is Vendr able to accept signed upload headers (x-qp-sig) and surface the signature in the ingestion record? We use that as an additional proof-of-possession in the CAIQ mapping.

Also, Mina asked that the steward role be locked to two people max during the upload window to reduce simultaneous attestation conflicts. If Vendr can temporarily gate steward approvals to two Vendr/steward accounts that would be ideal.

Thanks — also confirming the ops call for Wed 19 May 08:00 UTC works for our SRE (Laura will be on).

—Ben
Lead, Field Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@quantapay.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr presign window proposal and roles - QuantaPay

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps (action owners & deadlines):

1) Window locked: Tue 24 May 01:00–09:00 UTC (warmup 00:30 UTC). (Owner: Vendr / Samira)
2) Presign approach: QuantaPay will generate customer presigns; TTL <= 30m. Vendr confirmed ingestion supports SHA256 and will persist hash. (Owner: QuantaPay infra / Alex)
3) Manifest & sample mapping: Vendr to share JSON schema + CAIQ/SIG mapping by EOD Wed (Samira). (Attachment already includes first draft.)
4) Steward gating: keep steward approvals to two accounts (Mina + Laura) during the window; Vendr to temporarily limit steward approval concurrency. (Owner: Vendr support)
5) Export artifact: Vendr to supply a post-ingest export: [vendr_evidence_id, sha256, manifest_id, ingest_timestamp] within 48 hours of the window close. (Owner: Vendr support)
6) Ops call: Wed 19 May 08:00 UTC — Laura (SRE), Alex (QuantaPay infra), Mina (steward) attending. Samira will send calendar invite and join details.

If there are no objections, I'll mark the HubSpot deal D-3421 with the upload window milestone and attach the manifest schema.

—Nikhil
Senior Security Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
